title.original: TTrace: Lightweight Error Checking and Diagnosis for Distributed Training
title.zh: TTrace：分布式训练的轻量级错误检查和诊断
title.en: TTrace: Lightweight Error Checking and Diagnosis for Distributed Training

inclusion_reason.zh: TTrace 的轻量插桩、张量对齐、数值容差与缺陷定位构成可接入训练框架的系统化差分调试基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: TTrace's lightweight instrumentation, tensor alignment, numerical tolerances, and localization form systematic differential-debugging infrastructure for training frameworks.

abstract.zh: TTrace 通过把分布式训练的中间张量与可信参考实现逐层对齐，检测和定位不会触发显式错误、却会破坏训练结果的静默缺陷。
abstract.en: TTrace detects and localizes silent distributed-training defects by aligning intermediate tensors against a trusted reference implementation rather than relying only on loss or gradient curves.

problem.zh: 静默缺陷不会崩溃程序，训练损失等宏观信号既间接又无法定位根因，而浮点非确定性又会造成大量误报。
problem.en: Silent defects do not crash the program, aggregate curves are indirect and nonlocalizing, and floating-point nondeterminism can create false alarms during differential comparison.

approach.zh: 系统插桩记录两种执行的中间张量，按语义对齐后应用数学分析得到的容差，把正常数值误差与缺陷引发的偏差区分开。
approach.en: The system instruments both executions, semantically aligns their intermediate tensors, and applies analytically derived tolerances to separate expected numerical error from bug-induced divergence.

system_design.zh: 轻量插桩采集张量轨迹，对齐器匹配参考与分布式节点上的对应值，容差判定器标出首次异常位置并回传到相关算子。
system_design.en: Lightweight instrumentation captures tensor traces, an aligner matches values across reference and distributed runs, and a tolerance checker identifies the earliest divergence and maps it to the responsible operator.

key_results.zh: TTrace 在 Megatron-LM 的多种精度训练配方中发现既有和此前未知的静默缺陷，只需少量代码改动即可接入。
key_results.en: TTrace detects both known and previously unknown silent defects in Megatron-LM across several precision recipes while requiring little integration code.

limitations.zh: 方法需要可运行的可信参考和可比中间张量；超大模型的轨迹成本、非确定内核以及两边都存在的共同缺陷可能逃过检测。
limitations.en: The method requires a runnable trusted reference and comparable tensors; trace cost at very large scale, nondeterministic kernels, and defects shared by both executions can evade detection.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
